# Abdelhamid Attaby

> Staff software engineer, Ph.D. Fifteen years building and operating large-scale systems, including two years at GitHub (Microsoft). Twice a CTO. Currently a founding engineer building multi-agent AI systems at Flowdia. Based in New Cairo, Egypt; works remotely in any timezone. Open to Staff and Senior roles.

## Current role

Founding Engineer at Flowdia (Dec 2025 – present) — an AI application platform where specialised agents plan, design, build and ship production web apps end to end. He builds the agent orchestration and LLM integration layer across Elixir and TypeScript/Node.js.

## Selected background

- Co-founder, Bardy (2023–2025) — visual feedback and collaboration SaaS; Elixir, React, Chrome extension, AWS Lambda, Terraform. Wound down in late 2025.
- Senior Software Engineer, GitHub / Microsoft (2021–2023) — GitHub Projects with the Memex team: saved views, user-owned projects, the project GraphQL APIs, fast issues, the iterations field, the issue sidebar. Large-scale performance work and distributed data migrations inside the github/github monolith.
- VP of Engineering, Wuilt (2021–2022). Chief Technology Officer, Aster (2020–2021). Co-founder and CTO, Coligo Technologies (2016–2019).
- Ph.D. and M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering. Three peer-reviewed publications, 124 citations on Google Scholar. MBA in progress at AAST, expected 2027.

## Core skills

AI agents and agentic systems, agent orchestration, LLM APIs · TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Ruby, Elixir · Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Phoenix, NestJS · React, Next.js · PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis · AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform · microservices, event-driven and distributed systems, API design, CI/CD · technical leadership and mentoring.
